name: select-dependency-versions
job: Select package and runtime versions from live authoritative sources with exact versions, sources, and applied pins.

inScope: Querying the live authoritative source for current stable releases
Preferring the latest stable satisfying security and compatibility
Recording exact version and source URL or command
Applying pins and running install, build, and tests
outOfScope: Choosing versions from training data or tutorials

inputs: Active repo security and compatibility constraints
outputs: Chosen versions with live sources and commands run
Residuals from install, build, or test
failureSemantics: A version is rejected unless it came from a live registry or official channel in this session; pre-release channels are opt-in only; lockfiles are checked for vulnerable transitive versions.

outcome.observable: Selected versions trace to a live registry or release API with the exact source recorded, pins are applied in owning manifests, and the repo's install, build, and tests pass or residuals are explicit.
